comment: Checkpoint manifest for the local background-removal adapter. A checkpoint may be loaded or executed ONLY when its status is exactly "admitted"; any other value, or a missing status, is refused (fail closed). There is no environment-variable or flag bypass. A model becomes "admitted" only through a reviewed commit that records written permission for the exact checkpoint file (see Deliverables/Prototype/PROTO-BGR-BATCH-001/END_OF_BATCH_REPORT.md section 3). Experiment only: not an approved production model policy.
